description: This source file defines the MultipartUploadException class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling exceptions during multipart uploads. It extends RuntimeException and implements MonitoringEventsInterface, encapsulating the upload state and providing detailed error messages related to multipart upload failures.
